newsitem.title: CANADA: FORECAST - Canada rates, yields seen slowly rising.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Canada rates, yields seen slowly rising.

text.p: Canadian interest rates and bond yields, some of which are now at 37-year lows, are expected to rise gradually in the coming year, according to economists in a The first Reuters quarterly Canadian survey asked 24 economists in Canada and the United States to forecast key economic indicators for the next eight quarters. Some experts opted to forecast only certain items.
The consensus is that Canadian rates and yields have reached a trough and will rise slowly in coming quarters.
